acceptance_criteria: `pub struct ExtrudeHistory { pub start_cap: SubShape, pub end_cap: SubShape, pub sides: Vec<(SubShape, SubShape)> }`, documented (`sides`: edge of the input face → the side face it swept).

`Kernel::make_face_tracked(&self, plane, outer, holes) -> Result<(Self::Shape, Vec<Vec<SubShape>>), KernelError>`: the same face as `make_face`, plus for each loop (outer first, then holes in order) and each segment the face's edge built from it. Documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`.

`Kernel::extrude_tracked(&self, face, extent) -> Result<(Self::Shape, ExtrudeHistory), KernelError>`: the same solid as `extrude`, plus its history. `sides` has one entry per edge of the input face. Documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`.
`Kernel::sub_shape_bounding_box(&self, s, of: SubShape) -> Result<BoundingBox, KernelError>`, documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`.

Plate tests (behind `occt`): the #90 plate, a 40 × 25 rectangle from (0, 0) with segments in the order (0,0)→(40,0)→(40,25)→(0,25)→(0,0), and a circle of radius 5 at (20, 12.5) as a hole, on `Workplane::XY`. Boxes within 1e-6, volumes within a relative 1e-6: make_face_tracked loops [4, 1] ...; extrude_tracked Distance(10) volume 10000 − 250π ≈ 9214.6018, caps and sides boxes ...; side adjacency ...; Symmetric(10) caps at z = −5 and 5; tracked and untracked calls agree.

Errors, each with a test and never a panic: the input checks of `make_face` and `extrude` apply unchanged (one test each, e.g. an open loop and `Distance(0)`), `extrude_tracked` with `Extent::ThroughAll` is `InvalidInput`, and `sub_shape_bounding_box` with an index out of range is `InvalidInput`.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies. Every new shim function is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` block is in `ffi` and documented.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
